exact_reference_rule: Exact argmax Qstar with lexicographic tie break; fixed per board/query and separate from the V25 tolerance-optimal representative.
selected_margin_direction: selected action minus exact_reference_action; Qstar difference equals negative original first-action regret.
cross_budget_pair_rule: Use [CACHED32 selected action,CACHED24 selected action] at both endpoints; change is K32 margin minus K24 margin, keeping same-action zero rows.
mode_selection: Exact maximum value then lexicographic action; tolerance is not used for argmax.
counterfactual_metric_scope: Only root-action wrong and optimal-continuation R0; not a counterfactual complete policy value.
group_rule: Source V35 complete policy total_regret<=1e-10 defines each configuration correctness; retain all four groups, descriptive only.
primary_eligibility: One common whole-stream mask over all160 contexts and both configurations: valid source, exact state/policy/value reproduction, all legal root actions decomposable, numeric action/margin/cross-K identities pass.
primary_unit: Average ten queries within board, sixteen boards equally; paired pointwise 95% Student t Monte Carlo intervals over suffix streams conditional on fixed V35 boards/prefixes.
source_reproduction: Reproduce V35 original three-configuration quality and cost streams on their original masks; do not let new attribution availability discard old fees.
cost_policy: Preserve all V35 configuration costs including GAP24 plus original chain; count restoration, evaluation, analysis and retention as new diagnostic work, with no refund or new physical sampling.
evidence_scope: Complete retained CACHED24/CACHED32 endpoint attribution; oracle corrections are diagnostic only and do not rescue GAP24.

selection_rule.domain: ACTIVE H2 target with observed root actions; other supported inherited cases fall back to original selector
selection_rule.challenger: largest same-cache q_upper over other legal root actions; lexicographic action tie
selection_rule.signed_reach: math.fsum of empirical incumbent probabilities minus challenger probabilities for each common H1 successor
selection_rule.eligible: retained ACTIVE H1 state, nonzero signed reach, unobserved legal action with q_upper > state lower
selection_rule.fallback: original structural select_row, then inherited balanced repeat selection
